Title: Nitin's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nitin - 30 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Anjali - 55 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Nitin stands on the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Nitin, what's the plan today?"

[Nitin's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Anjali: "I'm ready!"

[Nitin's car crashes into a pole.]

Nitin (surprised): "What next?"

[Nitin is killed when a truck hits him.]

Anjali: "We will never forget you."
